case: NULLIF computed result CSV round trip preserves mixed runtime storage classes
contract: A computed NULLIF result has fallback NULL metadata while rows preserve INTEGER, REAL, TEXT, BLOB and SQL NULL runtime kinds according to native typeof().
A text value shaped like the reserved SQLite ANY CSV tag remains TEXT rather than being decoded as the tagged value.
CSV export/import preserves each result value and storage class in a STRICT ANY target table, verified with native typeof() and exact BLOB bytes.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib sqlite_nullif_any_csv_round_trip_preserves_runtime_storage_classes -- --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other computed functions, storage-class/affinity mixtures, additional consumers and installed editing remain open.
